This is Max Thomasberger's technical publishing site, covering quantitative
research, R, backtesting, statistics, data science, and software engineering.

[Articles](articles/index.qmd) are the main publication stream.
[Projects](projects.qmd) collects related software, including ledgr, an
open-source R backtesting and quantitative research framework.
